title: Nissth Diagnostic Bridge Command
description: Stack-agnostic command shape accepted by every Nissth Diagnostic Bridge binding. See CLAUDE.md §11.2. Bindings interpret the fields they support and ignore the rest; stack-specific filters go in scope.extra.

tool.description: Tool name registered by one of the installed bindings. Snake_case. Discovery: 'nissth-bridge --list-tools'.

mode.description: Mode name or letter shortcode. Per-binding semantics. Omit for tool's default mode.

context_id.description: Caller-supplied id for cross-call correlation. Echoed in report frontmatter when present.

scope.description: Optional query scope. All top-level keys are stack-agnostic; stack-specific filters belong in scope.extra.

package.description: Fully-qualified package, namespace, or module path. Stack interprets per its conventions (e.g., 'com.example.reservation' for Java, 'app/reservation' for Expo).

root_path.description: Filesystem or logical root path for the query. Project-relative.

names.description: Specific symbol, file, or identifier names to target.

file_extension.description: File extension filter, e.g., '.java', '.tsx', '.sql'. Includes the leading dot.

tag_filter.description: Binding-defined classifier (e.g., JUnit tag, route group, test suite).

max_depth.description: Recursion limit. -1 = unlimited. 0 = scope target only, no descendants.

profile.description: Runtime profile selector for stacks that have profiles (e.g., 'dev', 'test', 'prod' for Spring Boot).

extra.description: Binding-specific filters. Keys not defined in this contract live here. Bindings document their extra keys in their own README.

format.description: Report body format. Bindings MUST support 'markdown'; 'json' and 'flat_text' are optional.

destination.description: 'file' writes to AgentReports/Bridge/ and returns the absolute path. 'return' returns the report body string directly. 'console' prints to stdout AND returns the file path.

file_name.description: Custom filename without extension or path separators. Default: '<tool>_<ISO8601>.md'.

errorResponse.description: Shape returned by any binding when a command fails. See CLAUDE.md §11.2.

tool.description: Echo of the tool name from the input command.

stage.description: Which stage failed. 'parse' = JSON malformed. 'validate' = schema or contract violation. 'execute' = binding raised during the underlying operation. 'format' = report writer failed.

context_id.description: Echo of the context_id when present in the input.

reportFrontmatter.description: Mandatory frontmatter on every Bridge-generated report. See CLAUDE.md §11.3.

binding_version.description: Semver of the binding that produced this report.

scope.description: Echo of the scope object the command was invoked with.

source.description: How the data was sourced. E.g., 'live process pid 1234', 'AST parse of files under src/', 'jdbc query to postgres://...'.

source_state.description: Hash, timestamp, or commit ref pinning the data. E.g., git SHA, schema_version row, file mtime range.

guarantee.description: Human-readable freshness claim. E.g., 'compiled classes built at 2026-05-15T14:29:11; classpath unchanged since'.

contract_version.description: Version of this schema the report was generated against. Currently 1.
